quarterly_data.quarter: Anhui Tongguan Copper Foil half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Anhui Tongguan Copper Foil H1 2026 revenue RMB 4,021,121,522.41, up 34.16% (H1 2025: RMB 2,997,208,702.81), mainly on higher copper foil selling prices; operating cost up 27.37%, mainly on higher copper purchase prices; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 214,879,534.74, up 514.75% (H1 2025: RMB 34,954,022.34); net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 207,322,000.64, up 754.21%; operating cash flow RMB -285,030,070.75, improved 37.74% as some customers shortened payment terms. R&D spend RMB 55,607,875.14, up 25.31%.

quarterly_data.quarter: Anhui Tongguan Copper Foil half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Anhui Tongguan Copper Foil H1 2026 revenue by product: PCB copper foil RMB 2,506,790,672.73 (up 47.16%), gross margin 11.60% (up 6.04 pt); lithium-battery copper foil RMB 1,373,865,172.49 (up 20.87%), gross margin 3.77% (up 3.53 pt); copper flat wire and other RMB 76,493,017.19 (down 42.60%), gross margin -1.34%. Subsidiary Hefei Tongguan (PCB copper foil) earned net profit of RMB 2,873.14 ten-thousand on revenue of RMB 73,508.35 ten-thousand, up mainly on higher sales of RTF series foil and higher average processing fees; subsidiary Tongling Tongguan turned to a net profit of RMB 5,079.25 ten-thousand on revenue of RMB 138,125.67 ten-thousand on higher high-end foil sales and processing-fee income.

quarterly_data.quarter: Anhui Tongguan Copper Foil half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Anhui Tongguan Copper Foil H1 2026 operations (half-year report): electronic copper foil capacity 8 ten-thousand tons per year; H1 output 36,228 tons. The report says demand from the high-end server field was released quickly, further lifting demand for high-end copper foil and widening the industry supply gap, and that the company raised product processing fees at appropriate times and kept expanding the market share of high-value-added products. Inventory rose to RMB 965,302,373.60 at June 30 from RMB 693,522,531.86 at the start of the year.
